name: Ashlan Stonesmirk
summary: Ashlan Stonesmirk is a dwarven explosives expert assigned to the regiment guarding Dun Modr and the Thandol Span in the northern Wetlands. From there, he keeps a vigilant eye on regional dangers threatening the realm of Ironforge.

sections.title: An Expert on the Border
sections.body: Positioned at Dun Modr in the northern Wetlands, Ashlan Stonesmirk serves the regiment guarding the Thandol Span. His expertise with explosives makes him a useful contact when suspicious materials threaten dwarven defenses.

sections.title: A Dark Threat Looms
sections.body: When Chief Engineer Hinderweir finds a suspicious powder near the Stonewrought Dam, he sends it to Ashlan for examination. Ashlan identifies the powder as Seaforium and advises how to neutralize it.

faq.q: Where can I find Ashlan Stonesmirk?
faq.answer: In this era, Ashlan Stonesmirk is stationed at Dun Modr in the northern Wetlands, near the Thandol Span.
He is a dwarven explosives expert stationed with the regiment guarding Dun Modr and the Thandol Span. Hinderweir turns to him to identify a suspicious powder found near the Stonewrought Dam.
He assists adventurers during 'A Dark Threat Looms', examining suspicious powder sent by Chief Engineer Hinderweir.

angles.text: Stonesmirk represents the skilled specialists supporting Ironforge's soldiers along Khaz Modan's borders.
Assisting Ashlan secures the strategic corridor connecting Loch Modan to the Wetlands and northern Alliance territories.
